run_simul_st_evaluation: run simultaneous translation evaluation against a remote server using the evaluate CLI
run_local_evaluation: run local simultaneous translation evaluation with SimulSTLocalEvaluationService and an agent
reset_evaluation_server: reset the evaluation server session using the --reset-server flag
run_evaluation_with_scores: run evaluation and retrieve scores from the server using the --scores flag
run_evaluation_with_range: run evaluation on a subset of sentences using --start-idx and --end-idx
